description: Laddstationer is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Gävle kommun. Public charging stations owned by Gävle Energi are linked on the website The Municipality of Gävle disclaims all responsibility for any errors or changes in open data that has been supplied by Gävle Municipality to the consumer. Coverage: Gävle kommun. The portal shows the English title as "Charging stations" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Gävle kommun. Its keywords include EV charger, Electric vehicle, Laddare, Laddstation, Elfordon, Charging station. The listing shows 1 download or service links in HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
